Lucas Private Rules Reconciled v1.7
Owner: Lucas Buzek
Date: 2026-09-24

PURPOSE
Reconciles the v1.6 Private backup rules with newer explicit EDEN/AppDev decisions recovered from recent project conversations and canonical source files. This package is a RULES / CANON / MANIFEST reconciliation package; it does NOT claim to be a full recoverable source/runtime backup.

KEY CURRENT DECISIONS
- HEIMDALL is the doorway to EDEN and creates Custom Apps.
- HEIMDALL.CONDUCTOR is HEIMDALL's EDEN-wide voice/command interface. Deterministic/offline baseline; actual voice is independent of AI; optional native/local/provider AI.
- LCAS is retired from Apps/edenOS runtime and retained as in-Chat UI only. Apps/edenOS use actual UIX and truthful state contracts.
- BIFROST remains CONNECT & KEEP system gateway/infrastructure and is not a mandatory capability gateway.
- EITRI orchestrates Engineering. PROMETHEUS develops technology/prototypes. DAEDALUS engineers systems. FORGE v2.0 makes software.
- Own the domain; share the capability.
- Capability maturity is explicit and evidence-based.

See CANON/AppDevRules_v1.7.txt and CANON/SUPERSESSION_v1.7.txt.
